name: Colour Converter
tagline: Type a colour as HEX, RGB, HSL or a name and get it in every form, with a contrast check.
seoTitle: Colour converter: HEX, RGB, HSL and CSS names
description: Convert a colour between HEX, RGB, HSL and CSS names, pick one, and check its contrast against white and black. Free, nothing is uploaded.

specs.Reads: HEX (3, 4, 6 or 8 digits), rgb() and rgba(), hsl() and hsla(), and all 148 CSS colour names
specs.Writes: HEX, RGB, HSL and the nearest CSS colour name
specs.Contrast: WCAG 2 ratio against white and black: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.q: Which colour forms can I type?
faq.a: HEX such as #f80, #ff8800 or #ff880080, rgb() or rgba() such as rgb(255 136 0 / 50%), hsl() or hsla() such as hsl(32 100% 50%), or a CSS colour name such as rebeccapurple. You can also use the colour picker.

faq.q: How is the nearest CSS name chosen?
faq.a: The tool compares your colour with all 148 CSS colour names and picks the closest one by eye, using a weighted distance in RGB. It says when the match is exact.

faq.q: What do pass and fail mean for contrast?
faq.a: They follow WCAG 2. Normal text needs a ratio of at least 4.5:1 and large text (about 24 px, or 19 px bold) needs at least 3:1. The ratio is cut to two decimals, never rounded up. A see-through colour is first laid over white or black.
